cards.french: il n'en demeure pas moins que
cards.meaning: nevertheless; it remains true that
cards.example_fr: Il n'en demeure pas moins que le problème persiste.
cards.example_en: Nevertheless, the problem persists.
cards.note: Formal concession followed by an indicative clause.

cards.french: à cet égard
cards.meaning: in this regard
cards.example_fr: À cet égard, plusieurs études sont instructives.
cards.example_en: In this regard, several studies are informative.
cards.note: Useful for precise transitions.

cards.french: a fortiori
cards.meaning: all the more so
cards.example_fr: Cette tâche est difficile pour un expert, a fortiori pour un débutant.
cards.example_en: This task is difficult for an expert, all the more so for a beginner.
cards.note: A logical intensifier used in formal arguments.

cards.french: pour autant
cards.meaning: for all that; nevertheless
cards.example_fr: Les progrès sont réels. Pour autant, tout n'est pas résolu.
cards.example_en: The progress is real. Nevertheless, not everything is resolved.
cards.note: Signals a reservation after acknowledging a point.

cards.french: en l'occurrence
cards.meaning: in this particular case
cards.example_fr: En l'occurrence, nous devons examiner les chiffres.
cards.example_en: In this particular case, we need to examine the figures.
cards.note: Specifies the case under discussion.

cards.french: un écueil
cards.meaning: a pitfall; an obstacle
cards.example_fr: L'un des principaux écueils est le manque de coordination.
cards.example_en: One of the main pitfalls is the lack of coordination.
cards.note: Frequently used in analytical writing.

cards.french: une portée
cards.meaning: scope; significance
cards.example_fr: Cette décision a une portée symbolique importante.
cards.example_en: This decision has considerable symbolic significance.
cards.note: Portée depends on context.

cards.french: un constat
cards.meaning: a finding; an observation
cards.example_fr: Ce constat mérite une analyse plus approfondie.
cards.example_en: This finding deserves more in-depth analysis.
cards.note: Often introduces an assessment.

cards.french: sous-tendre
cards.meaning: to underpin; to underlie
cards.example_fr: Plusieurs hypothèses sous-tendent cette étude.
cards.example_en: Several assumptions underpin this study.
cards.note: Formal analytical verb.

cards.french: étayer
cards.meaning: to substantiate; to support
cards.example_fr: Il faut étayer cette affirmation par des preuves.
cards.example_en: We need to support this claim with evidence.
cards.note: Often paired with faits, données or preuves.

cards.french: découler de
cards.meaning: to stem from; to result from
cards.example_fr: Cette décision découle d'une longue réflexion.
cards.example_en: This decision stems from careful consideration.
cards.note: Expresses causal derivation.

cards.french: se heurter à
cards.meaning: to run up against
cards.example_fr: Le projet se heurte à plusieurs obstacles juridiques.
cards.example_en: The project is running up against several legal obstacles.
cards.note: Pronominal verb + à.

cards.french: une remise en cause
cards.meaning: a challenge; a questioning
cards.example_fr: Cette découverte entraîne une remise en cause des méthodes actuelles.
cards.example_en: This discovery calls current methods into question.
cards.note: Common in debates about established ideas.

cards.french: mettre en exergue
cards.meaning: to highlight; to bring to the fore
cards.example_fr: Le rapport met en exergue des disparités régionales.
cards.example_en: The report highlights regional disparities.
cards.note: Formal synonym of souligner.

cards.french: faire abstraction de
cards.meaning: to disregard; to set aside
cards.example_fr: On ne peut pas faire abstraction du contexte historique.
cards.example_en: We cannot disregard the historical context.
cards.note: Follow with de + noun.

cards.french: Encore faut-il que les moyens soient disponibles.
cards.meaning: The necessary resources still need to be available.
cards.example_fr: Encore faut-il que chacun accepte de coopérer.
cards.example_en: Everyone still needs to agree to cooperate.
cards.note: Encore faut-il que introduces an essential condition; subjunctive.

cards.french: Ce n'est pas tant le coût que le délai qui m'inquiète.
cards.meaning: It's not so much the cost as the delay that worries me.
cards.example_fr: Ce n'est pas tant la distance que la durée qui pose problème.
cards.example_en: It's not so much the distance as the time that is a problem.
cards.note: Ce n'est pas tant X que Y adds a nuanced contrast.

cards.french: À supposer qu'il accepte, que ferions-nous ?
cards.meaning: Assuming he agreed, what would we do?
cards.example_fr: À supposer que le budget augmente, quel serait notre plan ?
cards.example_en: Assuming the budget increased, what would our plan be?
cards.note: À supposer que triggers the subjunctive.

cards.french: Quoi qu'il arrive, nous respecterons notre engagement.
cards.meaning: Whatever happens, we will honor our commitment.
cards.example_fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, il faut agir rapidement.
cards.example_en: Be that as it may, we need to act quickly.
cards.note: Quoi que + subjunctive expresses regardless of what happens.

cards.french: Eût-il été prévenu, il n'aurait rien changé.
cards.meaning: Even if he had been warned, he wouldn't have changed anything.
cards.example_fr: Eût-elle su la vérité, elle aurait réagi autrement.
cards.example_en: Had she known the truth, she would have reacted differently.
cards.note: Literary inversion with pluperfect subjunctive; rare in speech.

cards.french: Si complexe soit-il, ce dossier mérite notre attention.
cards.meaning: However complex it may be, this file deserves our attention.
cards.example_fr: Si coûteuse soit-elle, la réforme est nécessaire.
cards.example_en: However costly it may be, the reform is necessary.
cards.note: Si + adjective + subjunctive + inversion is a formal concessive structure.

cards.french: C'est ce à quoi je faisais allusion.
cards.meaning: That's what I was referring to.
cards.example_fr: Voici ce à quoi nous devons réfléchir.
cards.example_en: Here is what we must think about.
cards.note: Ce à quoi refers to something introduced by à.

cards.french: Les données, dont certaines restent confidentielles, ont été publiées.
cards.meaning: The data, some of which remain confidential, have been published.
cards.example_fr: Les candidats, dont plusieurs viennent de l'étranger, sont arrivés.
cards.example_en: The candidates, several of whom come from abroad, have arrived.
cards.note: Dont can introduce a partitive relative clause.

cards.french: Il aurait fallu consulter les habitants.
cards.meaning: The residents should have been consulted.
cards.example_fr: Nous aurions dû examiner ces risques.
cards.example_en: We should have considered these risks.
cards.note: Conditionnel passé expresses regret or criticism of past actions.

cards.french: Faute d'avoir anticipé la demande, l'équipe a pris du retard.
cards.meaning: Because it failed to anticipate demand, the team fell behind.
cards.example_fr: Faute d'avoir prévu les coûts, le budget a explosé.
cards.example_en: Because the costs hadn't been anticipated, the budget ballooned.
cards.note: Faute de + perfect infinitive expresses lack of a past action.

cards.french: Non seulement il a réussi, mais il a aussi aidé les autres.
cards.meaning: Not only did he succeed, but he also helped the others.
cards.example_fr: Non seulement elle travaille, mais elle étudie aussi.
cards.example_en: Not only does she work, but she also studies.
cards.note: Non seulement ... mais aussi emphasizes two linked points.

cards.french: Loin de résoudre le problème, cela l'a aggravé.
cards.meaning: Far from solving the problem, that made it worse.
cards.example_fr: Loin de nous rassurer, cette annonce nous inquiète.
cards.example_en: Far from reassuring us, this announcement worries us.
cards.note: Loin de + infinitive highlights an opposite result.

cards.french: La décision prise, il ne restait qu'à agir.
cards.meaning: Once the decision was made, all that remained was to act.
cards.example_fr: Le travail terminé, nous sommes partis.
cards.example_en: Once the work was finished, we left.
cards.note: Absolute participial construction, common in writing.

cards.french: Les mesures ayant été adoptées, leur effet reste à évaluer.
cards.meaning: Now that the measures have been adopted, their effect remains to be assessed.
cards.example_fr: Le projet ayant été approuvé, les travaux peuvent commencer.
cards.example_en: Now that the project has been approved, work can begin.
cards.note: Compound participle can express prior action in formal writing.

cards.french: Il importe que chacun puisse s'exprimer.
cards.meaning: It is important that everyone be able to speak.
cards.example_fr: Il est souhaitable que le débat reste ouvert.
cards.example_en: It is desirable that the debate remain open.
cards.note: Impersonal expressions of importance often take subjunctive.

cards.french: Il serait réducteur de ramener ce débat à une simple question de coût.
cards.meaning: It would be reductive to frame this debate as merely a matter of cost.
cards.example_fr: Il serait réducteur de ramener la transition écologique à une question de coût.
cards.example_en: It would be reductive to frame the ecological transition as simply a cost issue.
cards.note: Formal way to challenge an oversimplification.

cards.french: Cette analyse mérite d'être replacée dans son contexte.
cards.meaning: This analysis needs to be put into context.
cards.example_fr: Cette statistique mérite d'être replacée dans son contexte historique.
cards.example_en: This statistic needs to be placed in its historical context.
cards.note: Useful for critical interpretation.

cards.french: Force est de constater que les résultats demeurent mitigés.
cards.meaning: We must acknowledge that the results remain mixed.
cards.example_fr: Après six mois, force est de constater que les résultats demeurent mitigés.
cards.example_en: After six months, we must acknowledge that the results remain mixed.
cards.note: Fixed formal formula introducing a finding.

cards.french: La question n'est pas de savoir si, mais plutôt comment.
cards.meaning: The question is not whether, but rather how.
cards.example_fr: La question n'est pas de savoir s'il faut agir, mais plutôt comment le faire.
cards.example_en: The question is not whether to act, but rather how to do it.
cards.note: Reframes a debate constructively.

cards.french: Il convient de distinguer les objectifs affichés des effets observés.
cards.meaning: We should distinguish stated objectives from observed effects.
cards.example_fr: Il convient de distinguer les objectifs affichés des effets réellement observés.
cards.example_en: We should distinguish stated objectives from effects actually observed.
cards.note: Precision in evidence-based arguments.

cards.french: À première vue, cette hypothèse semble plausible; elle exige néanmoins des preuves.
cards.meaning: At first glance, this hypothesis seems plausible; it nonetheless requires evidence.
cards.example_fr: À première vue, cette explication est cohérente; elle exige néanmoins des preuves.
cards.example_en: At first glance, this explanation is coherent; it nonetheless requires evidence.
cards.note: Balances initial impression and verification.

cards.french: Cela soulève une question de fond que nous ne pouvons éluder.
cards.meaning: That raises a fundamental issue we cannot evade.
cards.example_fr: La réforme soulève une question de fond que nous ne pouvons éluder.
cards.example_en: The reform raises a fundamental issue that we cannot evade.
cards.note: Use question de fond for underlying issues.

cards.french: Il n'est pas exclu que cette tendance s'accentue.
cards.meaning: It is possible that this trend may intensify.
cards.example_fr: Il n'est pas exclu que cette tendance s'accentue dans les prochaines années.
cards.example_en: It is possible that this trend may intensify in the coming years.
cards.note: Il n'est pas exclu que takes the subjunctive.

cards.french: La pertinence de cette solution dépend des critères retenus.
cards.meaning: The relevance of this solution depends on the criteria chosen.
cards.example_fr: La pertinence de cette solution dépend des critères retenus par l'équipe.
cards.example_en: The relevance of this solution depends on the criteria selected by the team.
cards.note: Highlights methodological choices.

cards.french: Il serait prématuré d'en tirer des conclusions définitives.
cards.meaning: It would be premature to draw definitive conclusions.
cards.example_fr: Au vu des premières données, il serait prématuré d'en tirer des conclusions définitives.
cards.example_en: Given the initial data, it would be premature to draw definitive conclusions.
cards.note: Shows analytical caution.

cards.french: Ce raisonnement se heurte toutefois à une objection majeure.
cards.meaning: However, this line of reasoning faces a major objection.
cards.example_fr: Ce raisonnement se heurte toutefois à une objection majeure concernant le financement.
cards.example_en: However, this reasoning faces a major objection concerning financing.
cards.note: Formal structure for counterarguments.

cards.french: Sans remettre en cause le principe, je m'interroge sur sa mise en œuvre.
cards.meaning: Without challenging the principle, I question how it will be implemented.
cards.example_fr: Sans remettre en cause le principe, je m'interroge sur sa mise en œuvre concrète.
cards.example_en: Without challenging the principle, I question its practical implementation.
cards.note: Respectful disagreement at an advanced level.

cards.french: Il faut garder à l'esprit que les situations varient considérablement.
cards.meaning: We must bear in mind that situations vary considerably.
cards.example_fr: Il faut garder à l'esprit que les situations varient considérablement selon les régions.
cards.example_en: We must bear in mind that situations vary considerably by region.
cards.note: Useful for qualifying generalizations.

cards.french: À défaut de solution idéale, nous devons privilégier l'option la plus viable.
cards.meaning: In the absence of a perfect solution, we must favor the most viable option.
cards.example_fr: À défaut de solution idéale, nous devons privilégier l'option la plus viable financièrement.
cards.example_en: In the absence of a perfect solution, we must favor the most financially viable option.
cards.note: À défaut de expresses the lack of an alternative.

cards.french: En somme, la prudence s'impose, sans pour autant freiner toute initiative.
cards.meaning: In short, caution is necessary without holding back every initiative.
cards.example_fr: En somme, la prudence s'impose, sans pour autant freiner les innovations utiles.
cards.example_en: In short, caution is necessary without obstructing useful innovations.
cards.note: Sophisticated balanced conclusion.
